title: Reads of a Framed Configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Boolean-alphabet Turing machine, choose a clock tape among its work tapes, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. For any six-tape configuration $c$ and any contents and head positions for the $M$ tapes, the six symbols read on the framed configuration's four core tapes, clock tape, and buffer tape, assembled in that order, equal the six symbols read from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: contents and head positions for the $M$ tapes
replaced:
The six symbols read by a framed configuration on the interpreter's active
lanes (the four core lanes, the retained clock lane, and the buffer lane)
coincide with the reads of the underlying six-tape interpreter configuration.
